reason: In packages/lib/server/service/__tests__/insightsBooking.integration-test.ts:332-343, the org-scope integration test uses toEqual on a Prisma.sql fragment containing ordered ANY(...) arrays for teamIds and userIds. Those arrays are built without sorting in packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts:150-169 from TeamRepository.findAllByParentId (packages/lib/server/repository/team.ts:185-198) and MembershipRepository.findAllByTeamIds (packages/lib/server/repository/membership.ts:402-420), neither of which specifies an orderBy clause, making the array order and test equality nondeterministic.
